title: Power Mean Estimation in Stochastic Continuous Monte Carlo Tree Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.06489v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) has demonstrated success in online planning for deterministic environments, yet significant challenges remain in adapting it to stochastic Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), particularly in continuous state-action spaces. Existing methods, such as HOOT, which combines MCTS with the Hierarchical Optimistic Optimization (HOO) bandit strategy, address continuous spaces but rely on a logarithmic exploration bonus that lacks theoretical guarantees in non-stationary, stochastic settings. translated_title: 随机连续蒙特卡洛树搜索中的幂均值估计
translated_abstract: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）已在确定性环境的在线规划中取得成功，但将其应用于随机马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）仍存在重大挑战，尤其是在连续状态-动作空间中。现有方法（如结合MCTS与分层乐观优化（HOO）老虎机策略的HOOT）虽可处理连续空间，但其依赖于对数探索奖励项，在非平稳、随机环境中缺乏理论保证。近期的进展（如POLY-HOOT）引入了多项式奖励项以在确定性MDP中实现收敛，但针对随机MDP的类似理论仍尚未建立。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的MCTS算法，专为连续随机MDP设计。该算法将幂均值作为价值回传算子，并结合多项式探索奖励来解决环境中固有的非平稳性……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向连续随机马尔可夫决策过程的新型蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，通过将幂均值作为价值回传算子并结合多项式探索奖励，解决了随机环境中固有的非平稳性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel MCTS algorithm for continuous stochastic MDPs, which integrates a power mean as a value backup operator alongside a polynomial exploration bonus to address the inherent non-stationarity in stochastic environments.
